text:
raja: Urgent Q — corporate card got declined at Heathrow, had to put hotel + an expedited passport replacement fee (~£320) on my personal card. I also needed about a3200 cash for same-day transit. Can I get an emergency cash advance? Will the embassy/passport fee be reimbursed?
people-ops: Sorry that happened. Short answers: yes, emergency advances are available for verified travel emergencies (manager signoff + finance pre-approve). Passport replacement fees incurred to continue business travel are reimbursable with embassy receipt.
raja: What proof do you need for the passport replacement? They gave a receipt and a stamped form but no itemized VAT line.
finance-kate: Receipt + any official form showing expedited service + copy of old passport or police report (if lost) are ideal. If visa/entry delay caused additional hotel nights, include those receipts and manager approval. We'll process reimbursement in the original currency.
travel-security: Also add a short incident note in the travel tracker (date, what happened). For lost/stolen passports we need you to register the incident for duty-of-care and emergency assistance.
raja: For the cash advance a3200, how fast is that processed? I had to borrow from a coworker to cover transit.
people-ops: Finance tries to process emergency advances same-day during business hours if manager signs off. Otherwise submit a flagged expense as "emergency advance request" and ping finance. Advances must be reconciled with receipts within 30 days; unused funds must be returned or will be offset on next payroll.
manager-jen: I approve an emergency advance for Raja. Please submit the advance request in Expensify and tag me for approval.
raja: Corporate card decline  any follow-up? worried about recurring declinations.
finance-kate: We'll open a ticket with card-ops to check the card. In the meantime, reimbursements for legitimate business charges on personal card require manager approval + receipts. If the card decline caused additional costs, include a note and we'll review for potential reimbursement/dispute.
expensify-bot: Checklists: 1) Upload embassy/passport receipt + stamped form. 2) Upload hotel + transit receipts. 3) Submit emergency advance request and tag manager. 4) Mark claim as "travel emergency". Claims submitted by 17:00 PT processed in ~3 business days after approvals.
raja: Thanks folks 9; will upload docs and request the advance now. Appreciate the quick help.
